008package paint.ui.dialogs;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintPrefs;
012
013import javax.swing.*;
014import java.awt.*;
015import java.io.File;
016import java.nio.file.Files;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018
019import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON;
020
021/**
022 * Validates and retrieves a usable project root folder path for the PAINT application.
023 * <p>
024 * If the stored path is invalid or missing the configuration file, the user is prompted
025 * with a warning dialog and a native macOS folder chooser to select a valid directory.
026 * The chosen path is stored persistently via {@link PaintPrefs}.
027 * </p>
028 */
029public final class ProjectPathResolver {
030
031    /**
032     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
033     */
034    private ProjectPathResolver() {
035    }
036
037    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038    // MAIN VALIDATION LOGIC
039    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040
041    /**
042     * Retrieves and validates the configured project root directory.
043     * <p>
044     * Steps performed:
045     * <ol>
046     *   <li>Reads the stored project path from {@link PaintPrefs}.</li>
047     *   <li>Checks that the directory exists and contains the required
048     *       {@code PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON} file.</li>
049     *   <li>If invalid, prompts the user with warnings and a native folder chooser.</li>
050     *   <li>Updates preferences with the newly selected valid folder.</li>
051     * </ol>
052     * <p>
053     * Returns {@code null} if the user cancels folder selection.
054     * </p>
055     *
056     * @return a valid {@link Path} to the project root directory, or {@code null} if the user canceled
057     */
058    public static Path getValidProjectPath() {
059
060        boolean needToAsk = false;
061        Path projectPath = Path.of(PaintPrefs.getString("Path", "Project Root",
062                                                          System.getProperty("user.home")));
063
064        // Validate existence of the configured path
065        if (!Files.isDirectory(projectPath)) {
066            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null,
067                                          "The configured project path is invalid:\n" + projectPath +
068                                                  "\n\nPlease select a valid project folder.",
069                                          "Invalid Project Path",
070                                          JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
071            projectPath = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"));
072            needToAsk   = true;
073        }
074
075        // Validate configuration file presence
076        if (!validateProjectFolder(projectPath)) {
077            projectPath = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"));
078            needToAsk   = true;
079        }
080
081        // Ask user to select a valid folder if required
082        if (needToAsk) {
083            Path chosen = chooseProjectFolder(projectPath);
084
085            if (chosen == null) {
086                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
087                        null,
088                        "No project folder selected.\nExiting.",
089                        "Operation Cancelled",
090                        JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE
091                );
092                return null;
093            }
094
095            projectPath = chosen;
096            PaintPrefs.putString("Path", "Project Root", projectPath.toString());
097        }
098        return projectPath;
099    }
100
101    private static boolean validateProjectFolder(Path projectPath) {
102
103        if (projectPath == null) {
104            return false;
105        }
106
107        // Normalize Windows weirdness: trim whitespace, resolve canonical path
108        try {
109            projectPath = projectPath.toRealPath().normalize();
110        } catch (Exception ignored) {
111            projectPath = projectPath.normalize();
112        }
113
114        // Build expected Experiment Info path
115        Path confPath = projectPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
116
117        PaintLogger.debugf("=== Project Folder Validation ===");
118        PaintLogger.debugf("projectPath = [" + projectPath + "]");
119        PaintLogger.debugf("confPath    = [" + confPath + "]");
120        PaintLogger.debugf("Exists      = " + Files.exists(confPath));
121        PaintLogger.debugf("IsRegular   = " + Files.isRegularFile(confPath));
122        PaintLogger.debugf("=================================");
123
124        // A missing configuration file is no longer fatal: the folder is accepted
125        // and the config is created with default values on first load (ConfigStore
126        // logs a warning when it does so). Only warn here; do not block the user.
127        if (!Files.exists(confPath) || !Files.isRegularFile(confPath)) {
128            PaintLogger.warnf("No configuration file at %s; it will be created with default values.", confPath);
129        }
130
131        return true;
132    }
133
134    private static Path chooseProjectFolder(Path currentDefault) {
135
136        String os = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase();
137
138        // macOS: use native folder picker
139        if (os.contains("mac")) {
140            FileDialog chooser = new FileDialog((Frame) null, "Select Project Folder", FileDialog.LOAD);
141
142            System.setProperty("apple.awt.fileDialogForDirectories", "true");
143            chooser.setDirectory(currentDefault.toString());
144            chooser.setVisible(true);
145            System.clearProperty("apple.awt.fileDialogForDirectories");
146
147            String dir = chooser.getDirectory();
148            String file = chooser.getFile();
149
150            // macOS returns folder name in "file"
151            if (dir != null && file != null) {
152                return Path.of(dir, file);
153            }
154
155            // user cancelled
156            return null;
157        }
158
159        // Windows/Linux: **use JFileChooser**, because FileDialog cannot select directories
160        JFileChooser chooser = new JFileChooser(currentDefault.toFile());
161        chooser.setDialogTitle("Select Project Folder");
162        chooser.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
163        chooser.setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(false);
164
165        int result = chooser.showOpenDialog(null);
166
167        if (result == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
168            File selected = chooser.getSelectedFile();
169            if (selected != null && selected.isDirectory()) {
170                return selected.toPath();
171            }
172        }
173
174        // user cancelled
175        return null;
176    }
177}
